---
title: "Catalog"
---

Every file on the server is listed in an
[intake-esm](https://intake-esm.readthedocs.io/) catalog: a CSV with one row
per NetCDF file, and a JSON descriptor that tells intake-esm how to combine
files into datasets. The catalog is rebuilt nightly.

## Location

| | |
|---|---|
| Catalog descriptor | `{{< var catalog_path >}}` (placeholder) |
| Current version | `{{< var catalog_version >}}` |

## Open it from Python

```python
import intake

cat = intake.open_esm_datastore("{{< var catalog_path >}}")
sub = cat.search(
    source_id="CESM2",
    experiment_id="historical",
    table_id="Amon",
    variable_id="tas",
)
dsets = sub.to_dataset_dict()   # {dataset key: xarray.Dataset}
```

The [quickstart notebook](notebooks/quickstart.ipynb) walks through this
end to end.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `master_id` | Dataset id without version, e.g. `CMIP6.CMIP.NCAR.CESM2.historical.r1i1p1f1.Amon.tas.gn` |
| `collection` | `cmip6` or `reanalysis` |
| `path` | Full path to the file under `{{< var vast_prefix >}}` |
| `activity_id` ... `grid_label` | CMIP6 DRS facets (empty for reanalysis) |
| `product`, `frequency`, `level` | Reanalysis product (`era5`, `20crv3`, ...), frequency, and level (`2m`, `sfc`, `prs`, ...); empty for CMIP6 |
| `variable_id` | Variable name (both collections); for reanalysis, the variable's name inside the file |
| `version` | CMIP6: dataset version directory, `vYYYYMMDD`. Reanalysis: the product version (e.g. `v3`) |
| `time_range` | Time range from the file name (reanalysis: the file's year; empty for single-file datasets) |
| `size_bytes` | File size |

Datasets are grouped by `master_id` and `version`, so a dataset key looks like
`CMIP6.CMIP.NCAR.CESM2.historical.r1i1p1f1.Amon.tas.gn.v20190308`. The
[browser](browse.qmd) uses the same keys, so you can paste them into
`cat[key]`.

## Using it without VAST access

The `path` column holds VAST paths. If you read the files another way,
replace the prefix before loading:

```python
cat.df["path"] = cat.df["path"].str.replace(
    "{{< var vast_prefix >}}", "{{< var https_prefix >}}", regex=False
)
```

Reading NetCDF over HTTPS works for small requests; for anything large,
download the files first (see the [download guide](download-guide.qmd)).

## Versions

The nightly build always updates `latest`. Dated snapshots (for example
`2027-01`) that do not change are planned so analyses can pin a version; how
often they are made and how long they are kept is still being decided.
